integrity: The result and analytic proof are included; executable symbolic and independent five-point circle diagnostics are supplementary, not a universal proof. No external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact Euclidean ellipse/regular-pentagon optimization only; no finite-sample inference, general n-gon theorem or noise stability. Priority is provisional given incomplete coverage of historical special-shape literature.
title: Sharp regular-pentagon capacity of ellipses and a contact-phase transition
